_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Sampeyan Pemain {player_id}, dolanan {num_rounds} ronde Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Sampeyan duwe $ {pool} kanggo dibagi ronde iki antarane sampeyan lan Pemain {other_id}.

Pemain sing ngusul:
  - Ngusulake tawaran: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Yen ditampa → Sampeyan entuk $(pool - X), pemain liyan entuk $X
  - Yen ditolak → Kalorone entuk $0
  - Tuladha: [Offer: $3]  utawa  'Aku rasa iki adil. [Offer: $5]'

Pemain sing nanggapi:
  - Milih tawaran karo [Accept] utawa [Reject]
  - Tuladha: 'Iki katon wajar. [Accept]'
            'Terlalu ora adil. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ronde {round_number} diwiwiti! ---
Pemain {proposer_id} dadi pemain sing ngusul, Pemain {responder_id} dadi pemain sing nanggapi.
round.accepted: Pemain {responder_id} nampa! Ronde {round_number} entuk: Pemain {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Pemain {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Total anyar: Pemain 0: ${total_0}, Pemain 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Pemain {responder_id} nolak tawaran! Ronde {round_number} entuk: Kalorone pemain +$0. Total tetep: Pemain 0: ${total_0}, Pemain 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Sing ngusulake kudu nggawe tawaran nggunakake format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Jumlah tawaran kudu dadi wilangan bulat sing sah.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Ora ana tawaran saiki kanggo nanggapi.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Pemain sing nanggapi kudu milih [Accept] utawa [Reject] tawaran.

outcome.win: Pemain {winner} menang karo total ${winner_total} vs Pemain {loser} total ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Narik! Loro-lorone pemain rampung kanthi total ${total} .
